scene_note: Fixed paint camera (the hall's own gameplay camera). spawn_player is off so NPC schedules and the clock cannot change a shot. Positions are painting units (x, z), origin mid-floor, -z toward the back wall.

shots.describe: The whole main hall of a neon arcade bar at night, seen from the fixed gameplay camera: back wall of upright cabinets under a mural, green-glass bar on the right, dance machines and a token machine on the left, open checkerboard floor, stained-glass doors at the bottom. No characters. A soft green absinthe mist leaking from the two claw machines' bases is an intended effect even though the reference does not show it; do not mark it down.

The same hall by day: daylight through the glass, neon subdued but still glowing, same layout. No characters. A soft green absinthe mist leaking from the two claw machines' bases is an intended effect even though the reference does not show it; do not mark it down.

The night hall with three men just inside the stained-glass doors, seen from behind, walking north. The reference shows the empty room; judge the room and how the figures sit on the floor (scale against the cabinets, feet grounded). A soft green absinthe mist leaking from the two claw machines' bases is an intended effect even though the reference does not show it; do not mark it down.

The night hall with three men on the open floor around the green-glass bar on the right, facing east. Judge the room and figure scale and depth ordering against the bar. A soft green absinthe mist leaking from the two claw machines' bases is an intended effect even though the reference does not show it; do not mark it down.

The night hall with three men on the open floor near the dance machines on the left, facing west. Judge the room and figure scale against the machines. A soft green absinthe mist leaking from the two claw machines' bases is an intended effect even though the reference does not show it; do not mark it down.

The daytime hall with three men standing on the open floor between the dance machines and the bar, facing the camera. Judge the room and figure scale and lighting match. A soft green absinthe mist leaking from the two claw machines' bases is an intended effect even though the reference does not show it; do not mark it down.

A close crop of one man standing on a dim arcade floor at night, facing the camera. The reference is his painted portrait: judge character design fidelity (face, spiky blond hair, sunglasses on head, shell necklace, navy sunset-palm tee, khaki cargo shorts, phone on belt, white socks, flip-flops, build and proportions), not the background. He is shown at in-game size (about a fifth of the frame height), so do not mark down for small size or soft detail; judge colours, shapes, proportions and outfit.

A close crop of one man mid-stride, three-quarter view toward the lower left, on a daylit arcade floor. The reference is his painted portrait: judge character design fidelity (clothing, colors, build, proportions, face) allowing for the different viewing angle. He is shown at in-game size (about a fifth of the frame height), so do not mark down for small size or soft detail; judge colours, shapes, proportions and outfit.
